title: Iran Team Melli Posts World Cup Kit Photos and Training Videos — Federation Signals Readiness Despite Government Impasse
detail: Iran's national football team (Team Melli) posted photos and videos on social media on May 5, showing players in their new home kit for the 2026 World Cup alongside training sessions held in Iran. Players including goalkeeper Alireza Beiranvand and winger Milad Mohammadi featured in the posts. The social media activity — coordinated by the football federation — came amid an ongoing impasse between Iran's Sports Ministry (which has declared the team 'under no circumstances' can play in the US) and FIFA (which confirmed Iran's participation at the May 1 Vancouver Congress). The posts signal that the football federation is continuing tournament preparations despite the government's stated opposition, with the provisional squad submission to FIFA due May 11. Iran FA president Mehdi Taj is expected to meet FIFA President Infantino in Zurich later in May to press for security guarantees.

media.caption: Iran's Team Melli posts World Cup kit photos — federation signals readiness even as government-FIFA standoff remains unresolved

title: Estevao Returns to Palmeiras for Rehabilitation — Brazil World Cup Hopes Remain in Serious Doubt
detail: Brazil forward Estevao (17, Chelsea) returned to his former club Palmeiras in Brazil on May 5 for hamstring rehabilitation following a Grade-4 (near-complete) muscle tear sustained during Chelsea's 1-0 loss to Manchester United on April 18. Chelsea and Brazil's national team were at odds over treatment approach — Chelsea wanted immediate surgery, while Brazil pushed for conservative rehabilitation to preserve the teenager's World Cup participation. The conservative route is being pursued, but a full recovery in time for Brazil's June 13 Group C opener vs. Argentina remains in serious doubt. Coach Carlo Ancelotti's squad announcement is scheduled for May 18 in Rio de Janeiro. Estevao joins Rodrygo (ACL tear, confirmed out since March 3) as Brazil's major pre-tournament injury concerns.

media.caption: Estevao returns to Palmeiras for rehabilitation — Brazil's teenage star in serious doubt for the World Cup opener vs Argentina on June 13
